content.title: AI Data Center Demand Leaves No Stone Unturned With New Geothermal Deal
content.summary: Geothermal and renewable energy company Ormat Technologies reported late Monday that it signed a 20-year power purchase agreement with AI data center designer/builder Switch.  Under the deal, Switch will purchase approximately 13 megawatts of renewable energy from Ormat's Salt Wells geothermal power plant located near Fallon, Nev. As part of the agreement, Ormat has the option to further expand the facility's output to Switch by adding an approximately 7-megawatt solar panel facility, to provide auxiliary power to the geothermal power plant.
